params.prompt: Macro cinematography in a pure black void: a single ring of molten ember-orange light hangs in darkness, softly glowing. The camera pushes slowly toward it, then accelerates through its glowing center - warm orange light blooms and streaks past the lens with subtle motion blur, tiny embers drifting, then resolves back to deep clean black. Premium, minimal, film-grade lighting, shallow depth of field, no text, no people, no objects other than the ring of light. Slow elegant pacing.
